title: Tychonoff: a product of quasi-compact spaces is quasi-compact
statement: Let $I$ be a set and for every $i\in I$ let $T_i$ be a quasi-compact topological space (every open covering has a finite subcovering). Then the product $\prod_{i\in I}T_i$ with the product topology (the topology with basis the sets $\prod_iU_i$, $U_i\subseteq T_i$ open, $U_i=T_i$ for all but finitely many $i$) is quasi-compact.
